authority: Shared CargoBalances keyed by stable commodity identity; FIFO CargoProvenance scoped to store and commodity; generated capacities/access remain unchanged.

broaderRequirements.text: Buying and selling are atomic conserved exchanges of cargo and currency.
Cargo must enter an eligible authoritative personal, ship, fleet, warehouse, army, or other explicitly supported store and must respect that store's capacity and commodity compatibility.
Warcraft items, units, frames, and cached price text are representations, never the authority.

Market stock/history, cargo stores and cost basis, processed transaction IDs, route/repetition history, realized profit, merchant standing, and unlocked benefits persist in campaign saves and across physical-map transitions.

Quests, exploration, ships/fleets, governments, wars, historical events, technologies, and institutions integrate through stable IDs and explicit modifiers rather than hardcoded Age of Sail content in the shared trade engine.

closedPortions.scope: Mixed buy/sell/transfer conserve quantities and currency with independent FIFO costs.
Existing personal, warehouse and vessel stores share their finite capacity across all compatible commodities.
Mixed balances, costs and history persist through fresh services, migration, travel and rollback.
Single-commodity live cargo authority gap repaired.

executedTests.validates: Registered buy/explicit transfer/sale journey compared at every step with headless balances, market stock, currency and FIFO cost.
Reverse sale order preserves each quantity, all currency and the exact 94 total acquisition cost.
Mixed capacity, incompatible destinations, insufficient selected commodity, ambiguous shorthand and duplicate transactions reject atomically.
Paged registered inspection; personal, warehouse and vessel checks retain physical presence, control and stale-selection rejection.
Uncosted mixed cargo cannot borrow another commodity cost basis or earn ordinary standing.
Fresh v4 reconstruction, malformed/duplicate/overflowing balances, mismatched summaries and cross-commodity provenance rejection.
Literal v2/v3 records preserve quantities, costs, uncosted portions, archival history and replay; unknown legacy identities stay separate.
Failed transactional storage preserves the old slot and live cargo; fresh services and physical travel/return preserve complete trade authority.
Late extension/party failures restore mixed balances, lots, other authority and projections together.
Two mixed stores retain destination FIFO, original identities, integer remainders and legitimate zero-cost lots separately per commodity.
Single-commodity prizes preserve unrelated destination cargo/provenance; mixed-source claims reject without loss.
